predictions.source_summary: templateName parameter from function callers (email validation and invitation flows), substitutions parameter from callers containing user/request data like room_id, sender, token, ipaddress, validation links
predictions.sink_summary: SMTP email sending via smtplib.SMTP.sendmail() with the formatted template as email body
predictions.guard_summary: No validation on template file path or content; string formatting directly applied to file content without sanitization; template files are configured paths but path resolution is not constrained
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled substitution values are directly formatted into email template content using %-formatting, allowing template injection if substitutions contain formatting specifiers; template file path is configurable but not validated for path traversal
predictions.context_summary: Email template system reads files from configured paths and applies string formatting with user-provided substitutions before sending via SMTP
unresolved_facts: Whether template files contain dangerous formatting specifiers
Whether substitution values are properly sanitized before being passed to sendEmail
If there are any constraints on template file path resolution

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
top_sast_rules.description: A string formatting operation, such as '"%s: %s, %s" % (a,b)', where the number of conversion specifiers in the format string differs from the number of values to be formatted will raise a TypeError.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to CWE-685. Review OWASP guidelines and CWE documentation for detailed mitigation strategies.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
top_sast_rules.description: Extracting files from a potentially malicious tarball using `shutil.unpack_archive()` without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can cause files outside the destination directory to be overwritten. More precisely, if the tarball comes from a user controlled location either a remote one or cli argument.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement path validation using canonical paths. Reject paths containing '../' or similar traversal sequences.

top_sast_rules.description: File access follows a symlink, hardlink, or shortcut to an unintended resource.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-59 symlink hardlink link-following symbolic-link file-link archive-extraction path-resolution file-overwrite race filesystem

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
top_sast_rules.description: A remote user-controlled data can reach a costly Unicode normalization with either form NFKC or NFKD. On Windows OS, with an attack such as the One Million Unicode Characters, this could lead to a denial of service. And, with the use of special Unicode characters, like U+2100 (℀) or U+2105 (℅), the payload size could be tripled.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement resource consumption limits, rate limiting, and proper cleanup mechanisms for all operations.
